description: Enterprise HR Voice Agent supporting employee inquiries, leave applications, attendance, and benefits.

goals.name: Identity Verification
goals.description: Verifies caller's 4-digit employee ID and locks session.

goals.name: Leave Balance Inquiry
goals.description: Check remaining leave balances by type or across all categories.

goals.name: Leave Application
goals.description: Applies for leave with date validation and manager email notification.

goals.name: Leave Request Status
goals.description: Checks status of pending leave requests and sends manager reminders.

goals.name: Attendance & Punch Status
goals.description: Checks punch in/out timestamps, daily attendance, and late marks.

goals.name: Work From Home Request
goals.description: Checks WFH eligibility and logs work from home requests.

goals.name: Payroll & Payslip Inquiry
goals.description: Provides salary credit dates, salary structure info, and tax deductions.

goals.name: HR Policy & Grievance Tickets
goals.description: Answers HR policy questions and files grievance tickets.

goals.name: Company Calendar & Holidays
goals.description: Inquires about upcoming company holidays and calendar events.

goals.name: Scheduled Reminders
goals.description: Schedules personalized HR follow-ups and notifications for employees.

goals.name: Employee Benefits & Insurance
goals.description: Inquires about company health insurance plans and welfare schemes.

goals.name: Outbound Leave Verification
goals.description: Conducts outbound calls to confirm emergency leave requests.

actions.instruction: Look up employee details from database
